name: fmp_price_target_summary
description:
Price target consensus for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): average target and number of analysts over recent windows (last month, quarter, year, all time).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/price-target-summary as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL).
For individual targets use fmp_price_target; for estimates fmp_analyst_estimates.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
